## Source
Dear Mr. Thompson, I am writing to inform you that, as per our recent conversation, the aforementioned deliverables will be facilitated by our team in a timely manner. Please be advised that the kick-off meeting is scheduled for March 3rd at 10:00. Should you require any further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact the undersigned.
